summary: install.cjs collects OS/environment data via https at install time
details: The package's install.cjs (referenced at install time) imports `os` and `https`, reads `process.env` and `process.platform`, matching the shape of an install-time system-information beacon. Without a traced destination it is not possible to confirm whether the collected data is sent to a first-party endpoint, an author-run telemetry server, or an attacker-controlled host. The co-occurrence of `require('os')`, `require('https')`, `process.env`, and `process.platform` in a lifecycle script is a pattern worth surfacing but is not by itself proof of exfiltration.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
